title: Ground cover: grass tufts, stones, face gravel, roots
summary: Instanced detail that makes procedural ground read as real: curved grass-blade tufts, scattered stones, gravel pressed into a cut face, half-buried stones and branching roots seated on a relief.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.import: import { grassTufts, stones, faceGravel, roots } from '../library/module.recon.ground-cover/index.js';
usage.example:
grassTufts(G, [[1.1, -1, .35, 3, .42], [2.4, -31, 2, 4, 1.9]]);   // [cx, cz, radius, clumps, height]
const R = reliefFaces(G); /* faces */ faceGravel(G, R.surf, { n: 450, x0: -10.5, x1: 11.5, y0: -5, y1: -.7, skip: (x, y) => x > -.6 && x < 1.2 });

doc.when: Any exposed ground or cut earth; a face without gravel reads as stucco, a top without tufts as a slab.
doc.avoid: Placing far tufts at their 'physical' size on a steep AI-image top: the image scales props up with distance (~2x at 25 m).
gotchas: faceGravel/faceStones/roots need surf(x, y) -> z of the face (module.any.relief reliefFaces().surf).

params.faceGravel o: n x0 x1 y0 y1 skip color seed
